headline: Nigerian Local Refineries Receive 127 Million Barrels of Crude in First Nine Months
summary: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission reported domestic crude supply of 127 million barrels to local refineries between January and September 2026 following interventions to mitigate supply bottlenecks.
why: Domestic refining capacity in Africa's largest oil producer is critical for reducing foreign currency expenditure on imported fuels.

impacts.name: Oil Refining
impacts.why: Higher crude deliveries ensure improved utilization rates for domestic refining facilities.
